title: Pilot Study Evaluating the Impact of Stress Reduction on Atherosclerotic : Heart and Mind Study
official: Pilot Study Evaluating the Impact of Stress Reduction on Atherosclerotic : Heart and Mind Study
summary: The plot study aims to evaluate the effect of 8 weeks of stress reducing intervention on atherosclerotic plaque inflammation in adults, as quantified by positron emission tomography (PET) with fluorine-2-deoxy-D-glucose (FDG) in individuals with increased psychosocial stress.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* • Aged between 30-65 years

  * Identifies as having increased levels of stress and/or has a Perceived Stress Scale (PSS) score \>5 at baseline, and is interested in participating

Exclusion Criteria:

* Perceived Stress Scale (PSS) score \<6
